vocabulary.en: You can notice patterns. You learn vocabulary, and you can recognize the grammar instinctively.
vocabulary.zh: 你可以注意到规律。你学会了词汇，并且能够本能地识别语法。

vocabulary.en: As you can probably tell, I use a range of different vocabulary and expressions.
vocabulary.zh: 你可能已经察觉到了，我使用了一系列不同的词汇和表达方式。

vocabulary.en: Plus, you'll find all the vocabulary from this episode on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
vocabulary.zh: 另外，你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到本期的所有词汇。

vocabulary.en: And at the same time, we will learn some important and useful English vocabulary!
vocabulary.zh: 与此同时，我们将学习一些重要且实用的英语词汇！

vocabulary.en: And remember, you'll find all the vocabulary from this episode on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
vocabulary.zh: 请记住，你可以在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到本期的所有词汇。

vocal.en: And finally, to stand up for someone means to be vocal in defending a person who is being bullied.
vocal.zh: 最后，“为某人挺身而出”（stand up for someone）意味着大声疾呼地为受到欺凌的人辩护。

vocal.en: But it isn't. It isn't natural at all. Scientific studies suggest that when we're born, our brains already have the networks that allow our eyes to see and our vocal cords to produce sounds, but not with the pathways we need to read.
vocal.zh: 但事实并非如此。一点也不自然。科学研究表明，当我们出生时，我们的大脑已经有了允许眼睛看到东西和声带发出声音的网络，但并没有我们阅读所需的神经通路。

voyage.en: What could be better, right?-- Yeah. Ocean voyages and dangerous missions and so on.
voyage.zh: 还有什么比这更棒的呢，对吧？是啊，远洋航行、危险任务之类的。

voyage.en: Apparently carbonated water was used to try to prevent scurvy on sea voyages.
voyage.zh: 显然，当时人们试图用碳酸水来预防海上航行的坏血病。

voyage.en: In its four year voyage, the Challenger discovered around 4,700 new species of marine life.
voyage.zh: 在其四年的航行中，“挑战者号”发现了大约4,700种新的海洋生物。

voyage.en: But the most influential moment of the voyage came on the Galapagos Islands, a volcanic island group near the equator.
voyage.zh: 但这次航行中最具影响力的时刻发生在Galapagos群岛，这是一群靠近赤道的火山岛。

voyage.en: And although they didn’t have boats like we imagined today, they would have made some short sea voyages over stretches of open water.
voyage.zh: 尽管他们没有我们今天想象的那种船只，但他们肯定在一些开阔水域进行过短暂的航海。

voice.en: Firstly, like most people, I really didn’t like the sound of my own voice.
voice.zh: 首先，和大多数人一样，我真的很不喜欢自己声音听起来的样子。

voice.en: If you cannot do the voice, you are not accepted as a real Punch man.
voice.zh: 如果你发不出这种声音，你就不会被认可为真正的 Punch 艺人。

voice.en: Like the passive voice or the imperative or conditionals, makes language functional.
voice.zh: 比如被动语态、祈使句或条件句，能使语言发挥实际功能。

voice.en: What was the voice? Hello? Oh dear. But embarrassment is more than just shyness and blushing.
voice.zh: 那是怎样的语气？哈喽？哦天哪。但尴尬不仅仅是害羞和脸红。

voice.en: But as the reactors went up, so did the voices of protest.
voice.zh: 但随着核反应堆拔地而起，抗议的声音也随之高涨。

vote.en: Is it: a) vote, b) people, or c) city? Hmm, that's a good question.
vote.zh: 选项是：a) 投票，b) 人民，还是 c) 城市？嗯，这真是个好问题。

vote.en: Some countries launched major advertising campaigns encouraging citizens to vote for their national monument.
vote.zh: 一些国家发起大型广告活动，鼓励公民为本国古迹投票。

vote.en: I said that 53% voted to stay part of France, which means 47% voted for independence.
vote.zh: 我说过53%的人投票留在法国，这意味着47%的人投票支持独立。

vote.en: I said that 53% voted to stay part of France, which means 47% voted for independence.
vote.zh: 我说过53%的人投票留在法国，这意味着47%的人投票支持独立。

vote.en: One district voted 80% for the Republicans and 20% for the Democrats in the last election.
vote.zh: 在最近的一次选举中，第一个选区有80%的人投给共和党，20%的人投给民主党。

volunteer.en: They were also charged and imprisoned. Then volunteers came to keep the shop open.
volunteer.zh: 她们也遭到起诉并被判入狱。接着志愿者们前来继续维持店铺运营。

volunteer.en: I thought that was really pretty crude. Henry Scholberg was one of the volunteers.
volunteer.zh: 我觉得那真的非常粗鲁。Henry Scholberg 是志愿者之一。

volunteer.en: I try to attend events and volunteer in different things when I can.
volunteer.zh: 只要有机会，我就会尽量参加各种活动并去做志愿者。

volunteer.en: The thing was, only one of the volunteers was actually a volunteer.
volunteer.zh: 问题是，这两名“志愿者”中，只有一个人是真正的志愿者。

volunteer.en: The thing was, only one of the volunteers was actually a volunteer.
volunteer.zh: 问题是，这两名“志愿者”中，只有一个人是真正的志愿者。

volcano.en: It is a tropical and volcanic island known for its mountains and forests and volcanoes.
volcano.zh: 这是一座热带火山岛，以其山脉、森林和火山而闻名。

volcano.en: By definition, an earthquake must break the earth's crust, and is caused by either the movement of tectonic plates or a volcano.
volcano.zh: 根据定义，地震必须破裂地壳，并且是由板块运动或火山引起的。

volt.en: At 300 volts, he refused to answer any more questions and begged to be let out.
volt.zh: 到300伏特时，他拒绝再回答任何问题，苦苦哀求让他离开。

volt.en: And sixty-five per cent of the participants administered the full 450-volt shock, the maximum voltage.
volt.zh: 而百分之六十五的参与者，一路加到了满格的450伏特——也就是最高电压。

voltage.en: And sixty-five per cent of the participants administered the full 450-volt shock, the maximum voltage.
voltage.zh: 而百分之六十五的参与者，一路加到了满格的450伏特——也就是最高电压。

voltage.en: Most predicted that very few people, perhaps one or two per cent, would go all the way to the maximum voltage.
voltage.zh: 大多数人预测，只有极少数人——大概百分之一到百分之二——会一路加到最高电压。

volume.en: So when you do more volume, your ability to withstand volume, your work capacity increases.
volume.zh: 所以当你增加训练量时，你承受训练量的能力，即你的工作能力就会增加。

volume.en: So when you do more volume, your ability to withstand volume, your work capacity increases.
volume.zh: 所以当你增加训练量时，你承受训练量的能力，即你的工作能力就会增加。

volume.en: It's like the amount of volume that goes into it before you're presented with their finished work.
volume.zh: 在最终作品呈现给你之前，他们投入的精力简直不可思议。

volume.en: He collected maps. He collected clocks. He had an enormous personal library that, after his death, was donated to what became the British Library: 65,000 volumes.
volume.zh: 他收集地图。他收集时钟。他拥有庞大的个人图书馆，在他死后被捐赠给了日后的英国国家图书馆：藏书量达 65,000 册。

volume.en: While Polish mathematicians had pioneered the first breakthroughs in understanding Enigma, the sheer volume, the amount, of messages being sent during the war was just too much for human minds to process.
volume.zh: 虽然波兰数学家在理解 Enigma 的初期取得了重大突破，但战争期间发送的密电数量实在是太庞大了，根本超出了人类大脑的处理极限。

vocational.en: Maybe in other countries too. People learn vocational or practical skills like construction or plumbing or hairdressing through apprenticeships in the UK.
vocational.zh: 也许其他国家也有。在英国，人们通过学徒制学习建筑、管道工或美发等职业或实用技能。

vocational.en: There has been a boom in vocational courses, courses that teach students practical skills and prepare them for a particular job or career: hospitality management, journalism, and so on.
vocational.zh: 职业课程出现了蓬勃发展，这些课程向学生传授实用技能，并为他们从事特定的工作或职业做好准备：酒店管理、新闻学等等。

voluntary.en: The Austrian School of economics argues, essentially, that the most effective economic system is one based on free markets and voluntary exchange, with minimal government interference.
voluntary.zh: 奥地利学派经济学实质上认为，最有效的经济体系是建立在自由市场和自愿交换基础上的体系，政府干预应降到最低。

void.en: And anyway, legally, a minimum turnout of 50% is required for a referendum to be binding, so the entire thing was declared null and void.
void.zh: 无论如何，从法律上讲，公投要具有法律约束力，最低投票率必须达到50%，所以整场公投最终被宣布为无效。

void.en: So, what happened? Well, the referendum, in the great tradition of Italian referendums, was declared void after only around 30% of the eligible population turned up to vote.
void.zh: 那么，结果如何呢？嗯，延续意大利公投的优良传统，在只有大约30%的有资格人口参与投票后，这次公投被宣布无效。

vow.en: On the one hand, they lived austere lives, vowing poverty and chastity, praying, and following strict religious rules.
vow.zh: 一方面，他们过着简朴的生活，发誓贫穷和贞洁，祈祷并遵循严格的宗教戒律。

vow.en: Now, how this device actually worked is still a bit of a mystery, because his diving partner, De Marchi, the man who later wrote an account of the adventure, took a vow of secrecy.
vow.zh: 至于这个装置实际上是如何工作的，现在仍然是个谜，因为他的潜水搭档德马基（后来写下这段冒险经历的人）发誓要保守秘密。

vowel.en: Choose one English sound each month, for example, “TH” or R/L or vowel contrasts, and then practice it for 10 minutes twice a week using any online tool you can find.
vowel.zh: 每个月选择一个英语发音，例如“TH”、R/L 或元音对比，然后使用你能找到的任何在线工具，每周练习两次，每次 10 分钟。
